lines.en: : Hey, Ayane. Are you-
: ...free?
: Sensei? What a crazy coincidence! I totally haven't been jumping out of my chair every time I heard footsteps in the hall at all.
: Well, how lucky of me to have shown up the one time you decided to do that.
: I'll wait until you finish speaking to open the door next time.
: I appreciate that. But anyway, do you want to hang out and maybe get some of that obsessive, slightly overbearing energy out of your system?
: Heck yeah I do! And for future reference, you don't even need to ask! I always want to hang out.
: The only thing is that we can't really hang out here this time.
: Did your air conditioner break or something?
: Huh? No, it’s nothing like that. Sana just fell asleep early.
: Huh? No, that’s not it. I’ve just been cooped up in there for too long and I want to get some air.
: Did you want to maybe go for a walk with me, though? We don't normally do stuff at night and I want to know how it feels to go adventuring alongside my future husband.
: I will agree only if you stop calling me that.
: That's fine. I guess we can just hang out in the hall instead.
: I just sure hope nobody hears all of the intimate details I am going to loudly bring up in conversation.
: Okay then. I guess we're going out after all.
: Yay! I only needed one threat!
: Just try not to bring up any of those intimate details outside either. I'm sure it looks bad enough for someone my age to be escorting a school girl in the middle of the night.
: The last thing I need is those people also hearing...whatever sort of stuff you planned on sharing.
: Got it. I'll be on my best behavior.
: Can you maybe be on someone else's best behavior instead? Because yours is still a little much at times.
: Hey! Have some more faith in me! I haven't even tried dragging you into a dark alley yet!
: Do you see now why I asked you to behave?
: Because you hate fun but you love me and want to make sure that nothing complicates our already complicated relationship?
: Yes? No?
: Let's just go.
Ayane and I leave the dorms together and walk a few blocks down the street to an area with a few local businesses- all of which have already closed down for the night.
Thankfully, the dorms are located in one of the nicer parts of town, so we're able to move around without ever feeling unwelcome or unsafe.
Not that I have much to fear being one of just several males in a world that, at least to me, is full of pretty much all small girls.
For Ayane's sake, though, I'm glad.
Despite how much she annoys me at times, I'd really prefer to keep her alive.
Because not only am I enjoying her presence the more time I spend with her-
But she is very fun to have sex with, and I would like to continue doing that.
: ...and so I told the cashier, ‘I don’t care what the limit is! I’m buying them all!’
: What are you going to do with that many hermit crabs?
: I don't know. That's a problem for future Ayane.
: I'll probably just keep them all in my room back at home and ask my butler to look after them.
: Did you know that he has a PhD in neuroscience?
: Then why exactly is he a butler?...And what does that have to do with hermit crabs?
: Beats me, but I'm glad he's around since I have no idea how I would have survived these last few years without him.
: Have things really been that tough over there?
: They've been things. Let's talk more about hermit crabs.
: I'm running out of hermit crab related banter, Ayane.
: Then I guess we'll just have to talk about how much we love each other.
Keeping up with Ayane in conversations is always a bit of a struggle.
I don't want to say something like she's not normal when, underneath it all, I think she kind of is.
It can just be a little exhausting trying to make sense of her train of thought when mine is constantly running way behind schedule.
: So, joking aside, how do you like this part of town?
: You've been spending a lot more time over here lately, so you've got to have at least some sort of opinion on it, right?
: It's...fine, I guess. Most of my time over here is spent inside of your room, though.
: Well, I like it here a lot.
: And it might sound a little weird saying this at my age, but I don't think I'd mind spending the rest of my life here if it really came down to it.

: Kumon-mi is kind of like the perfect city, isn't it? New things are always popping up...the weather is always great...and there's this huge sense of community since no one can leave or enter anymore.
: Do you have a problem with people from other cities or something?
: Of course not. I love everyone equally. And besides, Maya comes from outside of Kumon-mi and I'm with her basically every day.
: I just like how we're all kind of...part of something, you know?
: This is where I was born.
: It's where I met you.
: That alone is enough to make me want to stay here forever.
We keep walking as the night grows darker and an abundance of clouds begin to appear.
I doubt it will rain since that's just...not a thing I've ever seen around here, but I guess my subconscious disagrees as my own set of clouds begins to take shape within my stomach.
A gust of wind attacks us and I catch a whiff of some sort of flowery fragrance Ayane is wearing.
I can't pinpoint it, but it has a sort of calming effect that makes me feel like I'm being wrapped in an oversized blanket.
The problem with this is that it's the middle of summer-
And this is one of the very few occasions where I would prefer not to be touched.
: Can I ask you a really random question?
: How random, exactly?
: Do you remember what your first words were?
: Like, from when I was a baby? Of course not. There's no way I'd remember something like that.
: Maybe you wouldn't, but your parents probably would.
: I've never heard Ami mention grandparents, though, so I guess finding out might not be possible...
: If I had to guess, though...I’d say your first word was ‘Mama.’
: And why is that?
: Maybe because...you’re so good with girls?
: That might be true now, but I can't imagine I was this good with them when I was a baby.
: That's a good point. You've gotta remember that this is just a hunch, though. I am more than willing to accept defeat if you are able to confirm it was something else.
: How about you, then? What were your first words?
: You're good with me for the most part. So working off of your logic, wouldn't that mean yours would be like, Dada or Daddy or something?
Ayane becomes uncharacteristically quiet and I immediately recall her mentioning something about the slowly dissipating relationship between her and her father.
I don't think she worded it as eloquently as that, but given this reaction, I doubt I'm far off from the truth.
: Yeah...
: Yeah...I'm pretty sure that...was my first word.
: We can talk about something else now, if you want. I should have thought before saying that.
: Oh, you don’t have to worry about me. I’m okay.
: Just...a little nostalgic.
: But it'll pass.
: In the meantime, though, do you think that we can maybe stop at a convenience store or something?
: I’m still banned from a few of them, but I'm pretty sure there’s one close to here that we can still buy stuff from.
: What exactly did you do to get banned from so many convenience stores?
: That's for me to know and you to never find out!
Ayane and I wind up walking around for an hour or two before I bring her back to the dorm.
She was perfectly fine for the rest of our outing, so I guess the whole thing with her dad wasn’t as big of an issue as it may have seemed at first.
That’s good.
I’m not sure how I’d handle seeing Ayane as anything but...Ayane.
So I'll just...keep trying to avoid that line of questioning for as long as I can.
Change is scary, even if it's only temporary.
So I'll do everything in my power to change absolutely nothing.
And continue to absorb this brand new life- impurities and all.
Ayane’s affection has increased to [ayane_love]!
